title: StockSmart Credit Desk Table — Credit Limit Use and the Limit Share on a Converted Bin
content:
**Applies to:** the customer-owned fill-to level of a StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program bin converted from consignment at a par review.

**Rule.** The receivable balance of the customer's Commercial Credit Account divided by its credit limit sets the limit share: 1.0 or more puts 0.75, 0.8 or more but below 1.0 puts 0.9, and less leaves the limit share as it is; an account with no credit limit, or no account on record, counts as 1.0 or more.

| Receivable balance divided by credit limit | Limit share |
|---|---|
| 1.0 or more | 0.75 |
| 0.8 or more, below 1.0 | 0.9 |
| below 0.8 | unchanged |
| no credit limit, or no Commercial Credit Account on record | 0.75 |

**Hypothetical accounts.** Receivable 50000.00 on a 50000.00 limit: exactly 1.0, so 0.75. Receivable 40000.00 on that limit: exactly 0.8, so 0.9. Receivable 39000.00: 0.78, unchanged.
